name: EDW Health check monitoring
description: Exposes a Drupal site's core/module/theme versions, update status, cron, enabled-module list and server (PHP/DB) info as JSON at a permission-gated endpoint for an external monitoring server.
project_description: The EDW HealthCheck client module exports a Drupal application's status and versioning — core, contrib modules and themes with their update status, last-cron run, the enabled-module list, and PHP/database versions — as JSON at /edw_healthcheck/{type}. The endpoint is gated by an 'edw healthcheck access' permission and accepts HTTP basic auth, so an external EDW HealthCheck monitoring server can poll it with a dedicated account. Optional per-component plugins add a core status-report summary, dblog message counts and an inactive-accounts listing. Also ships legacy Drush 8 commands and a settings form.
